goal: Dynamically compute headers presync DoS protection parameters at startup instead of hardcoding them
Keeps sync parameters optimal as software ages and eliminates manual release preparation steps
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support with no open blocking objections (darosior, l0rinc)
Support because the approach is easier to grasp and the upper bound tradeoff is right (darosior)

why: P2 because headers presync DoS protection adapts over time instead of drifting from optimality

Eliminates recurring manual precomputation and potential for mistakes during release preparation
